page_summary: This section discusses the economic barriers to cybersecurity in ports, highlighting the uncertainty of cyber incident costs and the challenges in assessing potential losses. It emphasizes the importance of timely incident response and the collective action problems arising from information asymmetries. The text also addresses the risks of free-riding in cybersecurity efforts and the moral hazards associated with liability and investment in cybersecurity measures.
